script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server conversation wait "$K" --until running --timeout 60
control-agent-server state cat "server/workspace/conversations/$(echo "$K" | tr -d -)/base_state.json" --check execution_status eq running
control-agent-server restart --hard
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K" --check execution_status eq error --save F05.restart-hard-running/get
control-agent-server conversation events "$K" --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --key execution_status --contains '"error"' --save F05.restart-hard-running/status-events
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --query status=running --check . eq 0
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.restart-hard-running/rerun
control-agent-server conversation wait "$K" --until running --timeout 60
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/interrupt" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K" --check execution_status eq paused
control-agent-server doctor
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K" --check execution_status eq error --save F05.restart-hard-running/get
